newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH DURABLES PRODUCTION UP 19.2 PCT IN Q1.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH DURABLES PRODUCTION UP 19.2 PCT IN Q1.

text.p: Turkey's durable goods production rose by 19.2 percent to 1,008,510 units in the first quarter of 1997, from 846,152 units in the same 1996 period, the association of durables producers said in a report.
It said domestic refrigerator, dishwasher, automatic washing machine and oven sales rose by 21 percent to 825,358 units in January-March 1997, from the same period of 1996.
Total exports jumped 32.6 percent to 252,421 units and imports by 77 percent to 89,222 units in the first quarter of 1997, when compared with the same period last year.
The report said Turkey's customs union with the European Union, in effect since January 1, 1996 positively affected the exports.

Dishwasher exports soared 742 percent to 23,095 units in the first quarter, from the same 1996 period while oven exports jumped 129 percent to 49,370 units, washing machine exports 79 percent to 18,648 and refrigerator exports up two percent to 161,308 in the same period.
Refrigerator output ran at near full capacity with 386,051 units in the first quarter, with domestic sales up 12.5 percent at 243,779 over the same 1996 period.
Automatic washing machine output and sales both rose by 23 percent in the first quarter to 313,186 and 329,274, respectively.

Oven production jumped 52 percent to 214,512 and dishwasher output rose 46 percent to 94,761 in the first quarter compared to a year ago while oven sales rose 21 percent and dishwasher sales 38 percent to 149,668 and 102,637, respectively.
